integrity: Complete mathematical proof, independently reproducible finite checker, and explicit attribution of the earlier scalar cherry–Wiener theorem.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unrooted labeled unweighted trees, n>=4. The integer cutoff is asymptotic; older equivalent shellwise enumerators remain a priority risk. The scalar negative cherry–Wiener covariance was known earlier.
title: A sharp single crossing of cherry–distance-shell covariances in uniform Cayley trees
